description: Keep software repositories tied to clear intent, owned work, and verified evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Keep repository work scoped, owned, and verified.
interface.longDescription: A compact software delivery workflow with six routed lanes, an atomic human-readable task ledger, controlled agent roles, learned operations, and evidence-based closeout.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $lean-sdlc to route and complete this repository task with an owned task and verifiable evidence.
